blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla on Monday urged the Supreme Court (SC) to revisit the 2016 plunder doctrine that he said makes “the biggest syndicate the hardest to catch.” Remulla made the statement during his first annual report, where he mentioned that 39 cases have already been filed in connection with the flood control anomalies.
